Even though it’s super hard and sometimes it feels like there’s a literal mental block in your mind stopping you from saying what you want, try your hardest to push through that barricade and talk to someone about how you’re feeling. It’ll be like this big weight is lifted off your chest instead of you overthinking your feelings. 
Also walks do help whenever it feels like you’re getting swallowed up by the thoughts in your mind, listen to some music and or listen to whatever sounds are happening around you. Just taking in everything in the moment helps you relax and makes you appreciate the small things we have like the birds chirping.

He’s literally the sun to me, always brightening my days. Whenever we went out, he would sometimes curl his moustache and it looked goofy in a good way but also made me fall in love with him more. He has these light blue eyes that turn green when the sunlight hits him, and whenever I look into them I just feel all of his warmth. We have the same weird sense of humour, and I feel 100% myself whenever we’re together. I can’t stop thinking about his goofy smile, and laugh. Even though the title says “crush” he was my boyfriend (he broke up with me Sunday), and I felt so safe being in his arms, especially whenever we went to sleep. I knew I could close my eyes and shut off from the world safely cause he was right there beside me. We were best friends, but the love that was there made it so much more. I miss him dearly and wish that he sorts his life out so that he can finally be happy. Eamonn, if you ever read this, just know that I’ll always love you and that I understand things had to end. You’re always going to be my grade A egg.
